description: Interface languages, each named in its own language (Settings sorts them by that name). source: the language the code is written in. quality: the estimated quality of the translation (machine translations no native speaker has reviewed, French excepted), shown in Settings with an invitation to improve the others. right_to_left: the interface is mirrored. qt_locale: Qt's locale for numbers and dates when Qt does not know the code. lupdate_language: a language pyside6-lupdate knows, for codes its table lacks (only its plural rules use it). aliases: other codes a system may report. varieties: how a system language picks a variety: by script, then region, else the default ("" is no region).
